# Anton Batiaev

> VP Product & Engineering at Capital.com, running the trading-platform tribe;
> previously Revolut, CTO at Vega and Nevis, and Deutsche Bank. Ten years
> building execution, derivatives pricing, margin and risk systems. Also builds
> Fintecy (read-only portfolio and P&L aggregation) and SHIP (a typed knowledge
> graph for engineering teams).

This site hosts a free knowledge base — options, derivatives risk and a
reading list — plus a set of finance calculators. Everything runs client-side;
there are no accounts and no tracking beyond analytics.

## Free tools

- [Options P&L calculator — payoff, Greeks, breakevens | Anton Batiaev](https://batiaev.com/tools/options-pnl): Free options strategy calculator: exact expiry payoff, Black-Scholes and Black-76 P&L before expiry, Greeks, breakevens and shareable links. No signup, runs in your browser.
- [Dynamic hedging simulator — what the option premium actually buys](https://batiaev.com/tools/hedging): Sell an option, delta-hedge it to expiry and watch the premium leave through the hedge. Set the volatility you sold at against the volatility the market delivers. Free, runs in your browser.
- [Volatility smile from a quote board — implied vol, skew, curvature](https://batiaev.com/tools/smile): Enter bid and ask for a strip of strikes and get an implied volatility for each side, a fitted smile, and the strikes the market prices clear of its own curve. Free, runs in your browser.
- [How much is enough? — retirement Monte Carlo across ISA, LISA and pension](https://batiaev.com/tools/retirement): Model a UK retirement plan across an ISA, a LISA and a pension: contributions, growth, and spending it down. A thousand return paths give the chance the money lasts, the spending it could support, and where a plan fails. Free, runs in your browser.
- [Employed vs self-employed vs limited company — UK take-home 2026/27](https://batiaev.com/tools/take-home): Compare the same income as an employee, a sole trader, through your own limited company, or via an umbrella. 2026/27 income tax, Class 1 and Class 4 NI, corporation tax and dividend tax. Free, runs in your browser.
- [Startup vs hypergrowth vs enterprise — compensation comparison](https://batiaev.com/tools/offer): Compare compensation shapes, not salaries. Price a startup grant, a scale-up RSU package and an enterprise base as distributions — downside, probability-weighted and upside — after dilution and UK tax.

## Knowledge base

### Options

The concepts every strategy page assumes you already have.

- [What an option actually is](https://batiaev.com/learn/options/basics): Calls, puts, strike, expiry and the difference between intrinsic and extrinsic value — the vocabulary everything else assumes.
- [The Greeks, without the calculus](https://batiaev.com/learn/options/greeks): Delta, gamma, vega and theta as four questions about the same position, and which one actually kills you.
- [Implied volatility is the price](https://batiaev.com/learn/options/volatility): Why an option's quoted premium is really a volatility number, and what the smile is telling you.

### Strategies

One page per structure, each with a live payoff chart you can edit and open in the calculator.

- [Long call](https://batiaev.com/learn/strategies/long-call): The simplest bullish option: defined risk, unlimited upside, and a bill for time decay every day you are wrong.
- [Long put](https://batiaev.com/learn/strategies/long-put): Downside exposure with a floor on the loss — the cleanest way to be short without unlimited risk.
- [Covered call](https://batiaev.com/learn/strategies/covered-call): Own the underlying, sell someone the right to take it from you above a set price, and keep the premium either way.
- [Cash-secured put](https://batiaev.com/learn/strategies/cash-secured-put): Get paid to bid below the market, with the cash set aside to buy if you are filled.
- [Bull call spread](https://batiaev.com/learn/strategies/bull-call-spread): Buy a call, sell a higher one. Cheaper than the call alone, with the upside capped at the short strike.
- [Bear put spread](https://batiaev.com/learn/strategies/bear-put-spread): The same trade pointed down: buy a put, sell a lower one.
- [Long straddle](https://batiaev.com/learn/strategies/long-straddle): Buy the call and the put at the same strike. A bet on movement, indifferent to direction.
- [Short strangle](https://batiaev.com/learn/strategies/short-strangle): Sell an out-of-the-money put and call. Collect premium while nothing happens — and carry an undefined tail.
- [Iron condor](https://batiaev.com/learn/strategies/iron-condor): A short strangle with both tails bought back. Same idea, defined risk, smaller credit.
- [Long butterfly](https://batiaev.com/learn/strategies/long-butterfly): A cheap, narrow bet that the underlying finishes at a particular price.
- [Collar](https://batiaev.com/learn/strategies/collar): Hold the asset, buy a protective put, and sell a call to pay for it.

### Risk

How the positions above are margined and measured — the systems side, which is the part I actually built.

- [SPAN, and why your margin is not what you expected](https://batiaev.com/learn/risk/span): How exchange portfolio margining actually works: the sixteen-scenario risk array, spread charges, and the short option minimum that catches people out.
- [VAR, and what it does not tell you](https://batiaev.com/learn/risk/var-and-es): Value at Risk in one sentence, the three ways to compute it, the reason it is not a coherent risk measure, and why regulators moved to Expected Shortfall.
- [DV01 and the shape of rate risk](https://batiaev.com/learn/risk/dv01): The one number a rates desk actually watches, how it relates to duration and convexity, and why a single parallel shift is not enough.
- [Dynamic hedging, and where the premium goes](https://batiaev.com/learn/risk/dynamic-hedging): Sell an option, hedge it to expiry, and watch the premium leave through the hedge — why the price you collect is the price of the gamma you are short.

### Library

Where to go when this runs out — one page each for books, series and films.

- [Books](https://batiaev.com/learn/library/books): The reference texts worth owning, the narratives worth reading, and where to look when both run out.
- [TV series](https://batiaev.com/learn/library/series): Longer form gets closer to the texture of the job than any film has managed — desk culture, hierarchy, and the parts nobody puts in a prospectus.
- [Films](https://batiaev.com/learn/library/films): Which films get the culture right even when they bend the mechanics, and which ones to watch knowing exactly what they are.
